claims.label: Woman seen with shooter on nearby houses' doorbell-camera footage
claims.claim: The episode presents that a woman was captured alongside the shooter in doorbell-camera footage from houses near the venue, and that the FBI had not at the time of the episode publicly released or acknowledged that footage.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the underlying doorbell-camera footage independently; cross-check against FBI public statements and the TMZ September 11 release.

claims.label: George Zinn publicly endorsed Phil Lyman on his campaign website since at least June 2024
claims.claim: George Zinn was featured as one of approximately twenty endorsers on Phil Lyman's campaign website, with the text present on Wayback Machine no later than 2024-06-06.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify current status of the endorsement on the live Lyman campaign site; obtain Wayback snapshots across the full 2024-2025 window.

claims.label: State Farm Stadium memorial venue was secured via White House intervention, displacing a scheduled RV show
claims.claim: Turning Point USA did not book State Farm Stadium in advance; the White House placed a personal call to the event coordinator and obtained the date by rescheduling a previously booked RV show.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check White House and TPUSA communications logs; verify the RV-show organizer account.

claims.label: Lyman family member on camera suggested a "girl" may have acted as accomplice with the shooter
claims.claim: In footage recorded by Shainer Broadick, his aunt (identified as a Lyman family member) states on camera that she wondered if "the girl" had given the shooter items and that there might have been an accomplice.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify and interview the female speaker; obtain the original unwiped file; secure any raw footage she retained.

claims.label: Several new officials appeared in the case around the time of the assassination
claims.claim: Multiple senior officials involved in the case were recent appointments at the time of the event – FBI SAC "Robert BS" (installed by Kash Patel after a long DC tenure), hospital CEO and lead surgeon Andrew Zanger, Judge Tony F. Graph Jr. (fourth district court, appointed May 2025 by Governor Cox), and a new (unnamed) coroner.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm each appointment's date and predecessor; verify Andrew Zanger's direct involvement in Charlie Kirk's surgical care.

claims.label: An autopsy of Charlie Kirk was conducted
claims.claim: Despite public rumors to the contrary, an autopsy of Charlie Kirk was performed.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify through official medical examiner channels or court filings.

claims.label: Utah statute treats autopsy reports as private absent family-initiated release
claims.claim: Under Utah law, autopsy reports are kept private; only the immediate family's request can compel public release.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm against the current Utah Code provision on medical examiner reports and the practice of the named office.

claims.label: Netanyahu met on camera with US social-media influencer Deborah Lee
claims.claim: Benjamin Netanyahu conducted an on-camera meeting with US influencer Deborah Lee to discuss shaping US opinion, including in the context of Charlie Kirk's assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original full footage and timestamp metadata; identify any co-attendees not named in the clip.

claims.label: Netanyahu named TikTok and X (and Elon Musk) as the principal social-media platforms of the described "battle"
claims.claim: In the influencer meeting, Netanyahu identified TikTok and X as the most important battlegrounds, expressed hope that the TikTok deal would go through, and described Elon Musk as a friend to be spoken with.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the full exchange; verify the exact statements against the unedited clip.

claims.label: Netanyahu described social media as the "weapons of the battlefield" of the influence fight
claims.claim: In the meeting, Netanyahu stated, in essence, that the means of fighting must match the battlefield and identified social media as the most important battlefield of the present moment.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the full quote in its original-language form; identify the context (who prompted the metaphor).

claims.label: "Florida Dab" account on X demanded Megyn Kelly separate from Candace Owens
claims.claim: An X account identifying as "Florida Dab" publicly told Megyn Kelly she must separate from Candace Owens, or "many of us" would separate from Kelly.
claims.investigative_direction: Archive the original post; identify the account's operator; map its network of similar accounts.

claims.label: Megyn Kelly publicly refused to condemn Candace Owens or Tucker Carlson in the thread
claims.claim: Megyn Kelly publicly replied to Florida Dab and to Constantine Kissen that she would not separate from or condemn Candace Owens or Tucker Carlson, characterizing the demand as one she would resist.
claims.investigative_direction: Capture full thread context including replies not quoted on air.

claims.label: Constantine Kissen joined the X pressure thread against Megyn Kelly
claims.claim: Constantine Kissen posted on X to Megyn Kelly characterizing Candace Owens' and Tucker Carlson's behavior as "extreme and so deranged" and questioning why Kelly was not confronting them.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the post is from the same handle the host means; identify its operator and pattern of activity.

claims.label: TikTok Public Policy Manager of Hate Speech since July 2025 is described as a former IDF soldier
claims.claim: A producer-supplied note identifies "Erika/Erikica Mindle" as a former IDF soldier and as TikTok's Public Policy Manager of Hate Speech since July 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the named individual's employment, role title, and dates through LinkedIn, TikTok corporate disclosures, or press releases.

claims.label: The FBI recently cut ties with the ADL after Turning Point USA criticism, and the FBI and ADL share a building
claims.claim: A commenter states that the FBI has severed ties with the ADL in the wake of Turning Point USA criticism and that the two organizations shared a building.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against FBI press releases; identify the shared facility; check for any state or federal disclosure.

claims.label: One of Tyler Robinson's lawyers previously represented Richard Ramirez
claims.claim: One of Tyler Robinson's defense lawyers, Michael Bert, previously represented Richard Ramirez ("the Nightstalker").
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against state bar records and published case dockets for both Ramirez and Robinson.

claims.label: TPUSA event at USU on 2025-09-30 felt scripted and lacked open dialogue, per attendee email
claims.claim: An attendee of the TPUSA event at Utah State University on 2025-09-30 wrote to the show characterizing the event as scripted, lacking open dialogue, and not authentic.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent attendee statements; compare against TPUSA's published event format.

claims.label: Host says old photos show a younger Tyler Robinson visiting his uncle Mikey, whom she links to a Ukrainian battalion
claims.claim: The host says it is a fact that there are old photos of a younger Tyler Robinson visiting his "uncle Mikey", who she says works with a Ukrainian battalion and is a military man; she adds that she cannot confirm the uncle is Mike Mitchell and that this is still theory territory.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the photos the host refers to and establish who "uncle Mikey" is; check any Mike Mitchell link against the public record.
claims.transcript_snippet: It is a fact that Tyler Robinson, we can't confirm that this is Mike Mitchell, but there are old photos of Tyler Robinson when he's a lot younger visiting his uncle Mikey.

claims.label: Host says agents are surrounding Megyn Kelly to demand she denounce the host and Tucker Carlson
claims.claim: The host says that, for no apparent reason, "agents" she compares to Mr. Smith in the Matrix are surrounding Megyn Kelly and demanding that Kelly make a statement against the host and Tucker Carlson.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect the public posts demanding that Megyn Kelly denounce Candace Owens and Tucker Carlson and establish whether the accounts are coordinated.
claims.transcript_snippet: the agents like I think of them as like Mr. Smith in the Matrix have around I guess they're surrounding Megan Kelly and demanding that she makes a statement against me and Tucker Carlson.

claims.label: Host says locals describe George Zinn as a fixture at Republican events
claims.claim: The host says other locals told her that George Zinn is very involved in Republican politics and shows up to a lot of events, and that Phil Lyman's people would have controlled the campaign website that featured him.
claims.investigative_direction: Interview the locals and check county and state Republican event records for George Zinn's attendance.
claims.transcript_snippet: other locals told us that George Zinn, for whatever reason, is very in involved in Republican politics.

claims.label: Host says the receiving hospital was not the nearest and ranked low for neck trauma
claims.claim: The host says the regional hospital to which Charlie Kirk was taken was not the nearest hospital to the university and ranked extremely low among the hospitals best equipped for the neck wound he suffered.
claims.investigative_direction: Map hospital distances from the campus and compare published trauma-level designations of the nearer hospitals with the hospital used.
claims.transcript_snippet: although that was not the nearest hospital from the university and it also ranked extremely low in terms of the most uh best equipped hospital

claims.label: Host asks for information on whether the new hospital CEO and surgeon worked on Charlie
claims.claim: The host says she would like to learn whether the new hospital CEO and surgeon, Andrew Zanger, worked on Charlie Kirk, and asks anyone with that information to email the tip address.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the surgical team roster from the hospital or the death certificate and records through the family.
claims.transcript_snippet: I think it would be interesting to learn whether or not that new CEO and surgeon worked on Charlie.

claims.label: Host says Shainer Broderick deleted his social accounts after she asked him a question
claims.claim: The host says Shainer Broderick deleted his Facebook and LinkedIn and wiped his Instagram after she asked him a question before going live, and that her team had captured his content beforehand.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare archived captures of his accounts against the current state and ask him directly why he deleted them.
claims.transcript_snippet: just deleted his Facebook and just outright deleted his LinkedIn page because I asked him a question before we even went live.

claims.label: Host says a paid tipster told her the FBI is hiding doorbell footage
claims.claim: The host says that on a previous live show someone paid to inform her that the FBI was hiding footage, and that the tipster said the shooter is seen changing clothes with a woman and gave the name of another Lyman family member.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the earlier paid message and the tipster's identity, and compare her description with the doorbell footage released by TMZ.
claims.transcript_snippet: someone paid money uh to inform us that there was footage that the FBI was hiding.

claims.label: Host says Phil Lyman has been open that his family owned the property
claims.claim: The host says Phil Lyman has been forthcoming that his family owned the property near the shooting and that this is not mysterious.
claims.investigative_direction: Check county property records for Lyman family parcels on the route.
claims.transcript_snippet: He has been forthcoming about the fact that his family owned that property.

claims.label: Host says Utah Valley University bought its acreage from the Lyman family
claims.claim: The host says UVU in many ways purchased the acreage for the university from Phil Lyman's family.
claims.investigative_direction: Search Utah County deed and university land-acquisition records for the Lyman family transaction.
claims.transcript_snippet: UVU in many ways purchased uh the university from his family, right? That the the acreage from his family for that university.

claims.label: Host says TMZ already had the doorbell-cam footage on the morning of September 11
claims.claim: The host says that the very next morning, September 11, TMZ already had the doorbell-cam footage.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish TMZ's first publication time and source for the doorbell footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: you should recall that the very next morning on September the 11th, TMZ already had the doorbell cam footage.

claims.label: Host says the aunt is the woman who handed her footage to the FBI
claims.claim: The host says the woman heard on Shainer's clip is the person who handed her footage to the FBI, and that she has therefore confirmed twice, once from the aunt's own words and once from her source, that a woman was with the shooter.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the aunt's identity and whether she gave footage to the FBI and, if so, which files.
claims.transcript_snippet: now we have actually the woman who handed over her footage to the FBI saying, "I wondered if that woman was an accomplice, ladies and gentlemen.

claims.label: Host says the FBI did not tell the public during the manhunt that a woman was involved
claims.claim: The host says the FBI already had the footage and, during the 33-hour manhunt, chose not to inform the public that it was also looking for a woman.
claims.investigative_direction: Review FBI press briefings from September 10 to 12 for any mention of a second person.
claims.transcript_snippet: during this 33-hour manhunt, not to inform the public that they were also looking for a woman

claims.label: Host says Phil Lyman reacted angrily and asked whether she was involved in the shooting
claims.claim: The host says that after she asked Phil Lyman to track down the footage he became angry, said unkind things to her and asked whether she had something to do with the shooting.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the text or message exchange between the host and Phil Lyman.
claims.transcript_snippet: He's angry. I mean, he said really not nice things to me. He started asking me if I had something to do with the shooting.

claims.label: Host says Lyman told Fox News he had not seen the footage while his cousin gave it to TMZ
claims.claim: The host says Phil Lyman said on a Fox News segment with Kaylee McEnany that he was at a cousin's house watching live and seeing the footage for the first time, while the cousin had already given footage to TMZ.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the Fox News segment and compare Lyman's statements about where he was with the footage timeline.
claims.transcript_snippet: You were watching it live with Kaylee Mcaney on Fox News. That's what you said during that segment, right?

claims.label: Host says either the cousin or the feds gave the footage to TMZ
claims.claim: The host says there are only two options for how TMZ got the footage: the Lyman cousin gave it to TMZ, or federal agents gave a portion of it to TMZ.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask TMZ about its source and check the footage's chain of custody.
claims.transcript_snippet: Either your cousin gave it to TMZ or the feds gave a portion of it to TMZ

claims.label: Host asks for tips on who the woman was
claims.claim: The host asks viewers with any tips about who the woman caught on camera was to contact her.

claims.label: Host asks viewers to send tips rather than videos and says she may open a second line
claims.claim: The host asks viewers to use the tips address for information instead of sending videos, TikToks and links, and says the inbox is overloaded so she may set up a second line.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm whether a second tip line was opened in later episodes.
claims.transcript_snippet: there's only so much data that an inbox can take and we might have to just make a second a second line is what I think we should do.

claims.label: Host says one person next to Shainer was found to be from Austria
claims.claim: The host says viewers discovered that one of the people pictured next to Shainer was from Austria.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the Austrian national and verify his link to the Lyman family.
claims.transcript_snippet: We discover that one person was from Austria.
